title: A query needing an unconfigured composite index, with no firestore.indexes.json entry on either side
oracle: official Local Emulator Suite, pinned in ORACLE.md

steps.reason: Under firestore.indexValidationPolicy = firebase, a query whose composite index is not in the index file is refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION and the fragment production would need. The official Firestore emulator serves the query as if the index existed; firebase-testd offers that as the `emulator` policy instead of as the default.
Same policy difference for an equality plus an inequality on another field.

The same refusal reaches the gRPC client SDK as failed-precondition with the index fragment: the target is removed with FAILED_PRECONDITION while the stream (and the client) stays usable, so the promise rejects with the actionable message instead of resolving empty.
